item.title: Show HN: Context Mode – 315 KB of MCP output becomes 5.4 KB in Claude Code
item.description:

item.title: Ask HN: Share your productive usage of OpenClaw
item.description:
📝 It saw that another drive was perfectly healthy. It said the bad disc sectors were all early and probably just filesystem metadata and my files were probably fine. I probably would have thrown the whole box out, as I hadn't used it in a year and wasn't looking for a project like that.
